name: 🍕 Pepperoni Pizza Pasta Bake
what: Pasta and marinara baked with mozzarella and crispy pepperoni on top.

core.name: Pepperoni
core.out: skip it, or add sausage or veggies

extras: grated parmesan, oregano, garlic powder, mini sweet peppers, mushrooms

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 400°F. Big pot of salted water on.
Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than the box says. Save ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Stir the pasta with the sauce, the pasta water and half the cheese. Pour into a 9×13 dish.
Rest of the cheese on top, then pepperoni. Bake until bubbling and the pepperoni curls.

key: Pull the pasta 2 minutes early. It finishes in the oven without going mushy.
done: Bubbling at the edges and the pepperoni is crisp.
plan_b: No time to bake? Toss it all in the pot, melt the cheese on top, and eat.
